tests.description: End-to-end check of one WSM6 sub-time step assembled from the stage components: WSM6Saturation -> WSM6MeltingFreezing -> {WSM6WarmRain, WSM6ColdAccretion, WSM6IceDeposition} -> WSM6MassConservation -> WSM6SaturationAdjustment, coupled by variable_map param_to_var into the stages' `<x>_in` parameters. Reference: WRF 4.8 em_quarter_ss idealized supercell (GNU real32 build, dx = 2 km, dt = 12 s, 40 layers, WSM6 only) dumped by the instrumented ctessum-claude/WRF fork (module_esm_dump, esm_dump_inner hooks in mp_wsm6_run of the ctessum-claude/MMM-physics fork 52cfbd7) and replayed through the real64 (kind_phys = real64) kernels/wsm6_driver at the WRF sub-step, step 250 (t = 50 min), row j = 23, column i = 24. The only dumped inputs are the start-of-sub-step t, q, p, den, qc and the POST-SEDIMENTATION qi, qr, qs, qg (reconstructed from the dump's water and energy budgets, as in melting_freezing.esm's own tests) -- WSM6's sedimentation is an in-place semi-Lagrangian PLM update and not a rate, so no component of this repo can hand the melting/freezing block its input state; everything from there on is produced by the chain. Assertions are Linf_error over the whole 40-layer column against the dumped `<rate>_raw` rates, `<rate>_final` rates, `*_upd` state and pcond, i.e. every interface of the chain plus its end product. Nothing here is rate x dt (FORTRAN_BUGS.md N3), so the comparison is at the kernel's own sub-step. Regime: the LIQUID-DOMINATED mature storm core -- cloud water 2.3e-3 and rain 1.2e-2 kg/kg are the largest condensate of the storm, cloud ice 3.9e-4, snow 2.1e-3 and graupel 1.1e-2 kg/kg, freezing level at layer 9 with 8 layers above 0 C, so both branches of the melting/freezing block (melting of snow, graupel and ice below, homogeneous and heterogeneous freezing above) and both branches of the mass-conservation update are exercised, warm-rain autoconversion and accretion are at their column maximum and no budget is overdrawn (every conservation factor is 1 to 1e-16). Residual of the whole chain against the real64 replay, measured with zero tolerances (Linf over the column, as a fraction of that column's maximum): the melting/freezing outputs 0 (qs) to 2.4e-7; the start-of-sub-step thermodynamics xl 6.0e-9, cpm 3.4e-10, qsat_w 4.5e-7, rh_w 5.3e-7; the process rates 6.1e-8 (piacr) to 2.4e-6 (prevp), typically 2e-7; the rescaled rates identical to them because no budget binds in this column; the updated state T_upd 4.5e-9 (1.4e-6 K), qv_upd 7.8e-9, qc_upd 1.4e-7, qi_upd 2.9e-7, qr_upd 2.4e-7, qs_upd 7.6e-8, qg_upd 3.0e-7; and pcond 4.4e-6, the largest, because the saturation adjustment is a small difference of two nearly equal quantities evaluated at a state the chain has produced. That is one to two orders above the standalone components' own 1e-7 residual: the chain accumulates the real32 WRF constants of every stage (FORTRAN_BUGS.md N2), and the deposition budget and pcond amplify it by cancellation. Tolerances are set at a fixed fraction of each column's maximum -- 5e-8 for T and the latent heats, 5e-6 for the mixing ratios and the saturation state, 5e-5 for the process rates and 1e-4 for pcond -- i.e. 8x to 30x the measured residual.

input_qi.expr: qi_rates + np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) < 0, qc_rates - qc, 0) - np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, qc - qc_rates, 0)

input_qr.expr: qr_rates + psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw + np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, (t_rates - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) - (xls - xl)/cpm*(qc - qc_rates))*cpm/(xls - xl), 0)

input_qg.expr: qg_rates - pgmlt_raw - np.where(t0c - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) > 0, (t_rates - (t + xlf0/cpm*(psmlt_raw + pgmlt_raw)) - (xls - xl)/cpm*(qc - qc_rates))*cpm/(xls - xl), 0)
